summary: Icy Veins recut 35 letters, 2 M+ specs now TBD; Archon S2 raid nearly whole - survivability and 95th-pct HPS merged after 10 empty days. 25 consensus moves, at the anomaly limit.

sources.detail: A REAL RECUT, and a parser trap caught before it could publish. All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 192-340 KB. Parsed from the single tier-list table: the first <td> of each row is the letter and each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt is looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split at a space. THE LETTER MATCH HAD TO BE ANCHORED WHOLE-CELL: a first pass used /^([SABCDF][+-]?)\b/ and, because "+" is a non-word character, the \b forced a backtrack that read "A+" as "A" and "S+" as "S" on every plussed row - 38 phantom moves against 78 rows, exactly the shape the skill's "13 phantom S-/A-/B- moves" trap warns about. Fixed to a whole-cell alternation over the registered icyveins scale (S+|S|A+|A|B+|B|C) plus TBD. Per-page counts printed and reconciled against 27+7+6=40 BEFORE merging: raid 27/7/6 and M+ 27/7/6 = 80 rows, 0 unmatched. 35 letters moved, which is the largest Icy Veins recut on record here and is genuinely upstream: both DPS pages self-date dateModified 2026-08-23 (raid DPS 13:09Z, M+ DPS 15:31Z) against the 2026-08-16 we last read, and the whole M+ ladder was rebuilt around week-one live data - Elemental Shaman to S+, Retribution to S, Beast Mastery C->A, Augmentation A->C. TWO M+ DPS SPECS ARE PUBLISHED AS "TBD" - Windwalker Monk and Frost Death Knight - and are written as EXPLICIT NULL rather than left standing at their old S and A: "TBD" is a real upstream state, and holding a stale letter under a page that has withdrawn it is the same lie the season gate exists to prevent. Both now read "-" and average 3 sources in M+ instead of 4. Era read from each page's own title AND body: four titles self-identify Patch 12.1 / Season 2, the raid DPS page reads "Midnight (12.1)", and the raid HEALER page still carries the stale "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" title over a body whose ranking prose opens "Midnight Healer Tier List for Season 2" - body over title, the blue-tracker precedent. Devourer present in both DPS lists. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and no value changed, so freeze-season.mjs has nothing to do. published re-read per page from JSON-LD dateModified rather than carried forward, agreeing 6/6 with the pre-agent published-evidence/evidence.json, and FIVE OF SIX MOVED: raid DPS 2026-08-16 -> 08-23, raid healer 08-13 -> 08-24, M+ DPS/healer/tank 08-16 -> 08-23; raid tank alone unchanged at 08-08. Page snapshots advanced 08-24 -> 08-25.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 159/166 KB. Parsed from the tier__title markup blocks, each entry's data-original-title read as the "Spec Class" string and looked up whole. Raid 4 tier blocks totalling 40 rows (S 6 / A 11 / B 17 / C 6), M+ 40 rows (S 2 / A 13 / B 21 / C 4), 0 roster-matching unmatched, ZERO tier moves for the fourth night running. The M+ page again carries 8 tier blocks - 4 spec tiers plus 4 dungeon-difficulty blocks - and the extras were rejected by ROSTER MATCH rather than by position: King's Rest, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss and Altar of Fangs all fail to map, which is the intended behaviour. Era verified from the ranking body, not the title (both titles are bare "WoW Raiding/Mythic+ Tier List"): the raid page reads "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss", the M+ page "Method's Mythic+ Spec and Dungeon Tier List for Midnight Season 2" under Tactyks' byline. Devourer present in both at A - confirmed from the parsed rows, not from a body-text scan, since the spec names live inside attributes that tag-stripping removes. In-body dates unchanged from 08-22: "Last Updated 10th August 2026" (raid) and "13th August 2026" (M+); still NOT written to sources.json, because fetch-published.mjs does not cover method and a stored published value there would sit permanently un-cross-checked by the published gate - that remains an owner call. seasonVerified stays s2 on both. Page snapshots advanced 08-24 -> 08-25.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 73-339 KB. Parsed by unescaping backslash-slash to slash across the WHOLE document FIRST and then collecting every [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] block and selecting the one with the most [spec-badge=] hits, rather than anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml( - the anchor that returned 0 rows off the raid-healer decoy in the 08-01 incident. Exactly one block per page this time; badge counts 27/7/6 raid and 27/7/6 M+ = 80, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Tier labels matched with tolerant whitespace: S/A/B/C/D/F on the three raid pages and M+ healer, S/A+/A/B/C/D on M+ DPS (the documented A+, and still no S-tier spec in that cut), S/A/B/C/D on M+ tank. All six titles self-identify Midnight Season 2 and the bodies agree (S2/12.1 mentions run 40-93 against 7-18 for S1/12.0). published re-read per page from JSON-LD and unchanged, matching published-evidence/evidence.json 6/6: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 08-18, raid tank 08-14, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-18. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six. Page snapshots advanced 08-24 -> 08-25.

The Season-2 raid rebuild is nearly whole. All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 61-92 KB, parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists, entries resolved from each entry's icon "Class-Spec" token rather than the display name, with tiers[].entries treated as a list OF LISTS. RAID (metric "throughput"): 26 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 39 entries against 37 last night - Frost Mage and Affliction Warlock have RETURNED, and only Fire Mage is still absent from Archon's S2 raid list. Its stored raid letter was already explicit null and was re-written as null, so it keeps reading "-" and averaging 3 sources; the two returning specs go back to 4. Era-verified before merging: page.description reads "tier list for The Venomous Abyss ... in 12.1", specRankingsSection.title reads "DPS Rankings for Mythic The Venomous Abyss", Devourer present. M+ (metric "score"): 27/7/6 = 40 entries, 0 unmatched. lastUpdated advanced 2026-08-23T12:00:00Z -> 2026-08-24T12:00:00Z on all six pages, and the raid sample has grown by an order of magnitude (Arcane Mage 316 parses tonight against 1-79 across the whole cut last night), which is what a real week-one fill-in looks like rather than a re-clustering artifact. DOWNSTREAM, tonight's four tier sources together produced 25 consensus letter moves, ALL ONE BAND and none two-band, against anomaly limits of 25 total / 6 two-band - at the total limit but not over it, so the gate is not tripped and no ack is proposed. Most of that movement is the Icy Veins recut rather than Archon; Archon's own contribution is visible in the two raid cells whose source count went 3 -> 4 (Frost Mage B -> A, Affliction Warlock B at 4 sources) and in the two M+ cells that went 4 -> 3 as Icy Veins withdrew a letter (Windwalker Monk A+ -> A, Frost Death Knight A unchanged). Survivability is reported separately and is no longer empty.

Archon's Season-2 encounter rebuild is still HALF LANDED and was deliberately NOT merged for the second night. All 17 encounters were enumerated from the aggregate pages' encounterOptions (9 raid bosses: Nek'zali, Sentinels, Vashnik, Explorers, Sszorak, The Twin Fangs, The Coiled Altar, Ula'tek, Nymrissa; 8 dungeons: Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) and all 51 pages (17 x DPS/healer/tank) were fetched, HTTP 200, 0 failures. Result: every dungeon is complete at 40 tier rows (320), but only TWO of the nine raid bosses publish anything - Nek'zali at 39 rows and Lost Explorers at 27 - and the other seven return empty tier lists across all three roles. Total 386 rows against 619 stored, up from 356 last night. Rewriting the file with it would still be a 38% row drop, past the 25% maxRowDropPct limit AND below the 440 rows.min floor, and would publish a Season-2 fight view with two of nine bosses in it. So the stored Season-1 file is left byte-identical, its season stamp stays "s1" and the Fight selector stays hidden - which is the honest state, because the data in the file IS Season 1. The Per- page snapshots were deliberately NOT advanced: nothing was ingested, so claiming freshness there would green the staleness gate on data that did not move. The trend is right - 356 -> 386 in a night, and a full nine-boss set plus the 320 dungeon rows projects to roughly 640, comfortably over the floor.

THE SEASON-2 SURVIVABILITY LIST IS BACK after ten consecutive empty days, and it was merged. The read comes from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages - the same pages, the same parse path, no per-boss substitution - and tonight all three returned entries for the first time since 2026-08-16: 26 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 39 tiers (S 11 / A 13 / B 10 / C 5), 0 unmatched. 30 of the 39 moved against the stored Season-1 tiers and several move hard (Protection Warrior S -> C, Brewmaster A -> C, Holy Priest S -> B, Retribution B -> S, Arcane B -> S), which is expected: these are the first Season-2 raid survivability tiers this project has ever held, so they are a season change and not a night-over-night wobble. The one spec NOT covered is Fire Mage, absent from Archon's S2 raid list entirely; its stored tier stays at its own 2026-08-17 date rather than being guessed, and because spec.survivability carries a per-spec asOf that the drawer renders with a season chip, that single stale row is self-labelling rather than silently pooled - which is why a 39-of-40 merge is honest here where the same shape is not honest for the ranked numeric series. The per-boss pages were again explicitly NOT used: the 2026-08-21 measurement recorded in refresh-metrics settles that per-boss survivability is a fight artifact. Page snapshot advanced 2026-08-18 -> 2026-08-25 and its seasonVerified recorded s1 -> s2, which is the observation this ingest is based on (the page is ancillary, so it is outside the season gate and moves no consensus).

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" could have advanced and was HELD BACK again, on narrower grounds than last night. The Season-2 raid rankings table read from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data now returns 26 of 27 DPS rows plus 6 tank rows - up from 24 - and the sample is no longer thin: 918 parses across the whole cut last night against 316 on Arcane Mage alone tonight, with 22 of 26 DPS specs over 10 parses. Only ONE thing still blocks it: Fire Mage has no row at all, so merging would leave a single stale Season-1 DPS value inside a 27-row series that metricRanks pools within (role, bracket, name) with NO provenance key, and there is no way to write "unrated" for a number the way apply-ratings writes an explicit null for a letter. That one intruder would sit around rank 5 of 27 and shift every spec below it, so the bloodmallet precedent applies unchanged - adopt wholesale or not at all - and stored data is byte-identical with the coverage date correctly not moving. For the record the values are close, not wild, and none approaches the 60% maxValueMovePct. Merge wholesale on the first night Archon covers all 27 DPS specs; the standing-red label on this requirement should be rewritten then, because its stated cause ("0 rows, totalParses 0") stopped being the reason two nights ago.

MERGED, reversing last night's hold on purpose and for a stated reason. The healer raid page returned all 7 rows again (Holy Paladin 167 parses, Preservation 165, Restoration Shaman 137, Holy Priest 126, Discipline 72, Restoration Druid 54, Mistweaver 51), so this cut is COMPLETE within its role and its rank pool - (Healer, raid, "95th pct HPS (Mythic)") - contains nothing but Season-2 values. Last night held it not on data integrity but on optics, that advancing this requirement while the same page family's DPS third stayed stale would be "a green line drawn from half a table". That reasoning is coupling, and the split-row rule exists to prevent exactly it: archon-hps resolves its own coverage date from its own 7 rows, and refresh-metrics states plainly that a series that cannot be parsed is marked on its own row and must never leave the others stale by association. Publishing Season-1 HPS under a live-season label to keep company with a held DPS cut is the worse of the two errors. Values read as integers to match stored precision and n taken from each row's parses column; all 7 moved, 14.5% to 43.8% (Preservation 214,368 -> 308,348 the largest), every one inside maxValueMovePct. Note the parse counts FELL (Holy Paladin 390 -> 167) because these are Season-2 counts replacing Season-1 ones, not a shrinking sample. Coverage date advanced 2026-08-16 -> 2026-08-25.

Refreshed and merged: 40/40 rows advanced. All three Season-2 M+ pages returned specRankingsSection.table.data populated (27/7/6), values read as integers to match the stored precision and n taken from each row's parses column. Every row moved and every move is small and upward - max 2.05%, median well under 1% - with parse counts rising across the board, which is the signature of a genuine recut rather than a re-clustering artifact. Coverage date advanced 2026-08-24 -> 2026-08-25.

Two thirds of the series refreshed and one third was held, so the coverage date correctly does not move (the min-60th-freshest of 80 rows is still a raid DPS row at 2026-08-16). Merged: the 40 M+ rows as before, and - new tonight - the 13 RAID HEALER AND TANK rows, because those two role groups are COMPLETE at 7/7 and 6/6 and each sums to exactly 100.0 on its own. Held: the 26 raid DPS rows, because Fire Mage has no row and a 26-of-27 merge would leave one Season-1 share sitting inside a group that must sum to 100 - the merged part would sum to 100.0 and the stored intruder would push the published group to 101.5, which is a visibly broken series rather than a merely stale one. Shape-checked before merging exactly as the recipe requires: every value a plausible percentage, all six (role x bracket) groups summing to 100.00 at source, and no row equal to that spec's M+ score - the check that caught DPS magnitudes landing under unit "%" in an earlier run. Values stored to 1 dp to match the stored precision against a 2-dp payload. Raid DPS unblocks with archon-metrics, on the same Fire Mage condition.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers, no proxy, no auth; the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale prerender and was not touched. manifest.json returns snapshotDate 2026-08-11 and the rankings file carries Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT - the two AGREE, which is what distinguishes tonight from the 2026-08-04 incident where a pinned manifest hid a moved payload. The payload was diffed rather than trusted to the manifest anyway: 44 blocks, the three whitelisted categoryTypes (dps/hps/tank, sortField lowerBound, keyRange undefined - a whitelist, never a blacklist, because melee and ranged are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs) give 27+7+6 = 40 rows, all 40 matched the roster byte-identically and ALL 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts are unchanged. Upstream is frozen, not our fetch; nothing to merge means the coverage date correctly does not move and the 14-day staleness red stands as the honest signal. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED recorded on the requirement.

No WCL fetch by this agent: it holds no credentials and did not contact warcraftlogs.com by any transport, API or HTML. The row is written from the deterministic pre-agent step's wcl-fetch/evidence.json (attemptedAt 2026-08-25T11:02:36.939Z, this run), which reports verdict "rdps-broken": OAuth and GraphQL transport both healthy (rate limit 3600/hour, 1 point spent), and the single standing retry - characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 - returned HTTP 200 carrying a bare "Internal server error", so the redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream. evidence.landed is EMPTY and evidence.rawRecipes is empty, so nothing landed and no row may claim success. The frozen rDPS cuts are therefore unreachable and the stored medians stay byte-identical at 2026-08-10. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED recorded in required-sources.json: there is no Season-2 fetch path for zone 53 while the HTML statistics transport is Cloudflare-challenged and the API rdps family 500s, and the red IS the honest staleness signal.

No WCL fetch by this agent (no credentials; warcraftlogs.com was not contacted by any means). Same evidence file and same verdict as wcl-live-raid - wcl-fetch/evidence.json, attemptedAt 2026-08-25T11:02:36.939Z, verdict "rdps-broken", landed {} - so the zone-55 M+ medians cannot advance and the stored values stay byte-identical at 2026-08-10. Reported as its own row rather than coupled to the raid one so that a future partial restoration is visible per bracket. Owner-accepted standing red; it clears when a zone-55 recipe lands.

Fetched, parsed and merged, and UPSTREAM HAS RECUT AGAIN. All three meta pages by plain browser-UA GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 41-71 KB. The parser was rebuilt this run after the previous shape (split on <h3>) returned 0 of 40 on a healthy 200 - the spec name is not an <h3> element but a <div class="h3"> inside each meta-item anchor, and a zero-row parse on a live page is indistinguishable from an outage unless the count is printed, which is why it is. Entries are now split on the meta-item class, the spec name taken from the entry's own class="h3" divs and looked up WHOLE against the roster (the rank number is a sibling div of the same class, so the name is selected by roster match rather than by position), and the rating read from the infobar list item that follows the svg. 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched. All three pages self-identify "Midnight Season 2" and "Patch 12.1". ALL 40 VALUES MOVED, max 11.4% and nothing near maxValueMovePct: Arms 3367 -> 3402, Arcane 3387, Elemental 3354. asOf is 2026-08-25 taken from the pages' OWN <time datetime="2026-08-25T02:45Z"> stamp rather than from the run clock - murlok publishes a machine-readable update time next to its relative "Updated 46 seconds ago" text, so the honest date is available and was used. The number stays labelled a top-50 CEILING (the average rating of each spec's own best 50 players), never popularity. Page snapshots advanced 08-22 -> 08-25.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 attempts each. 17 returned data and 10 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every attempt - Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms and Fury, the EXACT set recorded as persistent on 2026-08-20 and again on 08-24, with control specs succeeding interleaved in the same minutes, so the endpoint is healthy and those ten simply have not been re-simmed. NOTHING WAS MERGED: all 17 available charts read simc_settings.tier = MID2 while all 26 stored profiles are MID1, and a two-tier pool is exactly what validate.mjs fails outright - rightly, because fightLabels pools every DPS profile into one flat array with no provenance key and MID2 runs a measured mean 1.79x MID1, so the ST/cleave/AoE labels would publish "which specs bloodmallet has re-simmed" as spec strength. Adopt wholesale or not at all; "adopt what exists, null the rest" is separately blocked by the 15-row floor and the 19-of-26 row-drop floor. Movement worth noting for the handoff: the three Warlock charts re-simmed on 2026-08-24 (the other 14 still read 2026-08-19), so upstream is actively working through the roster. Stored data byte-identical, the 48-day staleness red stands, and the handoff is unchanged: the night all 27 charts return MID2 is a wholesale adoption that WILL need a human value_move_ack, because MID2-vs-MID1 moves most rows far past maxValueMovePct.

Hold-MID1 again, and the objection has narrowed to one thing. MID1_Raid.txt is 272 bytes - a run that has just started, with no "DPS Ranking:" block - so the recipe falls through to MID1_Raid.html, which is byte-for-byte the same completed report that produced the stored values: header "SimulationCraft 1205-01 for World of Warcraft 12.0.7.68974 Live (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974, git build 678e66d384)". The git build HEAD is the documented freshness detector and it has not moved, which is the honest explanation for an unchanged parse, so nothing was merged. TWO PIECES OF GOOD NEWS for the handoff. (a) MID1 ITSELF IS NOW BEING REGENERATED AT A 12.1 LIVE BUILD: the in-progress txt header reads "SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69465 Live (hotfix 2026-08-25/69465, git build HEAD 91edd10b21)". If that run completes, the stored series can advance under its own name at a live 12.1 build with no tier-mixing question at all. (b) MID2_Raid.txt now HAS a "DPS Ranking:" block at the same 12.1.0.69465 Live build, so the 08-21 "PTR" objection is long gone. What still blocks MID2 is completeness: its ranking block carries 36 profiles covering 18 of the 26 DPS specs, with no Druid, no Evoker, no Demon Hunter DPS and no Retribution, Arms or Fury - eight of the same ten specs bloodmallet cannot re-sim either, which continues to suggest one upstream module rebuild rather than two independent outages. Holding MID1 keeps the series internally comparable; the honest cost is that the stored numbers are a 12.0.7 report a week into 12.1, and the 17-day red says so. OWNER NOTE, repeated from last night: this requirement's label still says MID2 is "12.1.0.69382 PTR" - that is no longer true and the label should be rewritten to name completeness as the only remaining objection.

Fetched and parsed cleanly, and upstream has NOT recomputed since last night. /period/latest 302s to /period/1077 (200, 199,856 bytes) and the body names it "Period 1077 MID2" - the same period this project first ingested on 2026-08-24. The parse is BOUNDED to the "Spec representation in top keys" section and ends at the next h2, which is what keeps the "Classes and specs" block and the per-dungeon sections from inflating 40 rows to 59; labels normalised on [-\s]+ in both directions and the value taken from the span AFTER the bar, never the bar's own height style. 39 rows parsed, 0 unmatched, and ALL 39 are byte-identical to stored. The series identity check still passes: total 100.3% with role subtotals DPS 60.1 / Tank 20.0 / Healer 20.2, i.e. the representation SHARE column and not the /meta per-key-presence figure that measures 7-10x higher. Nothing was merged and the asOf was deliberately NOT bumped to today: the stored 2026-08-24 is the date this period was first observed, and re-stamping unchanged data with a fresh date is precisely the freshness lie the coverage-date gate exists to catch. The 40th spec is Fire Mage, which the chart omits entirely - its stored value is already 0 at its own 2026-08-22 date and was left alone, because "absent from the chart" is an upstream absence and inventing a measurement for it would be a guess. Page snapshot not advanced, for the same reason.

Every channel swept and ONE REAL FINDING, which turned out to be PvP-only. Three live channels: the Wowhead news RSS (40 items, parsed per <item> block and never by tag adjacency, bodies free in content:encoded, newest Mon 24 Aug 22:54 CDT), the news INDEX payload data.news.newsData (20 posts, anchored on the id attribute and brace-balanced string-aware, newest id 382597) and the blue-tracker payload data.blueTracker.default (66 KB, 50 entries, 42 unique topics after deduping by topic id, newest 2026-08-25 02:01). NO 12.2 SIGNAL ANYWHERE: all 40 RSS bodies plus every index and tracker title were scanned for "12.2", "next major patch", "PTR is now available", "PTR Development Notes" and "Public Test Realm" - zero hits. Dev-notes thread 2317811 re-polled and still at highest post 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31), the closed cycle's expected silence. THE FINDING: forum topic 2339812 "Class Tuning Incoming - August 25", the source of the logged 08-22 feed entry, was EDITED to version 2 at 2026-08-24T21:44:22Z - it was still v1 when checked 24 hours ago - and Wowhead re-headlined its mirror news=382565 "(Updated) ... Restoration Druid Tuning Added". Read in full, the edit is explicitly PvP-only ("we have decided to make a few additional updates for the PvP tuning this week") and changes NO PvE value: it attaches "Does not apply to PvP combat" to two Restoration Druid lines already logged here at the same PvE numbers, and adds PvP-combat-only changes for Fire Mage Burnout and Arms Warrior Slayer's Strike. Per the PvP scope rule those two are deliberately NOT written as spec highlights; the two Resto Druid clauses gained a "PvE only" marker to match the Preservation/Affliction/Demonology lines that already carried one, the line still classifies null, and the entry's label records the whole amendment with its date. NO NEW FEED ENTRY was created, because there is no new PvE tuning. The EU mirror topic 626484 ("Class Tuning Incoming - 26 August") received the identical v2 edit at 21:46Z and is the same pass, not a second one. Also swept and correctly NOT logged, each read rather than judged by title: news=382597 "Mythic+ Tuning Changes Now Live" (Murder Row and Blinding Vale trash/boss tuning, zero class lines), news=382564 Concealed Pistol, the Trading Post and Burning Crusade Anniversary items, and the Race-to-World-First day recaps. The running hotfix topic 2336376 is still v15 at updated_at 2026-08-22T01:46:38Z, so no August 23/24 hotfix section has been added. No set bonus was touched by anything tonight, so no spec.tierSet needed advancing. PTR zone sweeps (54/52/56/57) remain dormant between cycles and were not attempted; their contract rows were removed at the flip.

A full sweep and one distillation: 1 video distilled into 4 takes, 3 older takes superseded, 2 queued. DISCOVERY: 44 unique YouTube channels polled (41 class-lane + 3 general), every one HTTP 200 on the FIRST attempt, 0 feed errors, no backoff needed. The seen-set was rebuilt from the four structured lanes (seen[] 549 + skipped[] 409 + videos[] + the youtu.be ids cited in takes/metaNotes = 1,196 ids), never from log prose; 660 feed entries yielded 142 unseen inside the cycle bound 2026-06-18 (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, derived with Math.min rather than indexed), 0 unseen predating it. DISTILLED from transcript-fetch/ (summary.json verdict "ok", requested 1, fetched 1): MadSkillzzTV's qG-So9pnRBQ, a 9h33m week-one healer stream published 2026-08-22, into FOUR takes, all inside his registered healer scope and all era-framed "Season 2 live", never "Season 2 PTR". Holy Paladin RAID (mixed) - he calls it the outlier of the healer roster, "Paladin felt very strong", every ability visibly moving the healing bars in a way he says is not true of other healers, and reads that as unsustainable rather than durable, guessing a 5-8% nerf off the heroic-week logs; mixed rather than buff because the read points both ways and mixed correctly abstains. Holy Paladin M+ and Restoration Shaman M+ (both buff) - he names those two as the pair "going to probably dominate" keys, and uses them as the bar a third spec falls short of. Holy Priest, unbracketed (buff) - asked directly whether Restoration Shaman or Holy Priest is the better spec, he answers both are "doing quite well" and relatively easy. DELIBERATELY NOT DISTILLED from the same stream: the "this is really bad this season" passage at 162m, because the referent is a chat question that never appears in the caption track and attributing it to Preservation Evoker would be inference, not distillation; and the tier-set comparisons at 481m, because "new set beats old set" is a gear claim and not a spec-strength read. SUPERSEDED 3 within the same lens only - his 08-09 Restoration Shaman M+, 08-12 Holy Paladin M+ and 08-15 Holy Priest both-bracket takes. His 08-04 Restoration Shaman RAID take is a different lens and stays live, and the new Holy Paladin raid take supersedes nothing because he had no live raid take on it. Lane hygiene per the precedence ladder: qG-So9pnRBQ was removed from videos[] on distillation and confirmed absent from seen[] and skipped[]. QUEUED 2 for the next drain, keyword-filtered as the nightly lane requires against the 100-request monthly Supadata budget: LoCCPjj7J6c (Dalaran Gaming, "If You Aren't Playing These 5 Specs in Season 2...You're Missing Out", an explicit spec-strength video inside his Druid/Hunter/Mage/Rogue/Shaman scope) and igWiPoYPlV4 (Musguete, "Assassination Rogue is Broken! Season 2 Guide", inside his Assassination scope). The other ~140 unseen stay UNSEEN on purpose - launch-week and RWF stream VODs, boss/dungeon/UI guides, spec how-tos and Supatease clip-shaped uploads whose media:description merely repeats the title - so the next run reconsiders every one of them; nothing was retired to seen[] tonight, because no dismissal this run was durable. No creator showed coverage outside their registered specs, so nothing is flagged for a scope widening. MadSkillzzTV's `latest` was NOT advanced: his entry is managedBy "overrides" and data/community-overrides.json is owner-curated and off-limits to this agent (Gate 0 applies it before its boundary diff), so the change is flagged here for Riley instead. yt-dlp was not invoked: the settled 2026-07-17 datacenter bot wall makes it useless from a runner, and nothing was installed or upgraded.
